# tenancy.CreateUnitInput

<!-- Generated by `pnpm contracts:catalog`. Do not edit. -->

Creates a unit under a project or unit (`core.unit.create` at the parent; depth limit 6).

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Id | `tenancy.CreateUnitInput` |
| Kind | `command` |
| PII | `none` |
| Tenancy scope | `project` |
| Permission | `core.unit.create` |

## Fields

| Field | Required | PII | Description | UI |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | yes | `none` | Display name of the new unit. |  |
| `parentUnitId` | yes | `none` | Parent unit in the same project; null (default) creates it directly under the project. |  |
| `settings` | no | `none` | Regional overrides; absent fields inherit from the parent node. |  |
| `type` | yes | `none` | Registered unit type; it must allow the parent. |  |
